label.trigger: A terratest helper logs from inside a subtest (t.Run or a table-driven case), so the running test's name is a slash-separated path such as TestParent/case_a, and the run's output is later split into one file per test by the log parser.
label.expected_impact: The prefix that DoLog writes keeps only the segment of the name ahead of the first slash, so every logged line of a subtest is tagged with its top-level test. The parser files each line under the name it reads from that prefix, so subtest lines end up in the parent's log file, parallel subtests of one parent are interleaved there, and each subtest's own file keeps only its status and result lines.

context_locations.note: Both log-line branches take the test name straight from the line: the first space-separated token on the stdout path, the token after the t.Log decoration otherwise. Whatever DoLog puts there decides which per-test file the line goes to.
